subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split Feishu outbound hook parity from normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening, and which seam should own the outbound fix?
rationale: The outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but normal-channel claim expansion changes plugin authority and security-sensitive ordering for every channel, so automation should not bundle or decide that API boundary.

options.title: Split outbound from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` parity through the chosen shared or Feishu-local dispatcher seam, and open or use a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

options.title: Fold outbound into the broader hook PR
options.body: Move the Feishu acceptance criteria into the existing outbound hook-bypass candidate PRs and keep this issue focused on inbound-claim API design.

options.title: Design all hook changes together
options.body: Use one broader design PR for outbound parity and inbound claim expansion, accepting slower review and higher compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Split outbound from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` parity through the chosen shared or Feishu-local dispatcher seam, and open or use a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined signal from current hook-dispatch history, Feishu-adjacent commits, and discussion naming them for plugin-hook semantics.
